## About
American Ghost Adventures is a locally owned and operated ghost tour agency based on E. Pine Street in Orlando, and the longest-running ghost tour agency in Central Florida. We run investigative ghost tours in Orlando, Mount Dora, Deland, Winter Garden, New Smyrna Beach and Sanford.
Our founder and lead investigator, Ting, has had the paranormal in her life for as long as she can remember. Our guides won't just tell you stories. They bring you into our haunted partner venues so you can be part of the story, whether you're a seasoned ghost hunter or it's your first time.
Guests have rated us 4.9 from 814 Google reviews. No one here is trying to scare you. Come with an open mind and let us show you our world.

## Services
- Ghost investigation: A guided ghost investigation. One reviewer's investigation with Emilio ran 2 hours.
- Mount Dora ghost tour: An evening through downtown Mount Dora and its haunted history. One reviewer took this tour with Ting as their guide.
- Deland tour with Kathy: Kathy leads guests through Deland to learn more about what may or may not still be out there.
- Tours in Winter Garden, New Smyrna Beach and Sanford: Investigative ghost tours are also offered in these Central Florida towns.

## FAQ
Q: Will we definitely see a ghost?
A: We can't promise that. Sightings and direct activity don't happen on every investigation. We work with the paranormal, but the ghosts aren't on the payroll.

Q: Can I bring my kids?
A: Our tours are family friendly. You know your children best, so their maturity level should guide whether they come along.

Q: Is the tour meant to scare us?
A: No. Nobody here is trying to frighten you. The goal is to teach you about the reality of the paranormal.

Q: How do I make a reservation?
A: Give us a call or email americanghostadventures@gmail.com. We're open every day.
